Help Scout Partner Program

# Great platform, even better partner

Help Scout works with partners to mutually improve customer retention, bridge gaps in product features, and ultimately provide more value to our communities at scale.

###### It just makes cents

From account mapping to co-selling to go-to-market collabs, we can grow better together.

###### Our friends are your friends

Let's join forces to share data, resources, introductions, and contacts to close more deals, faster.

###### We're at your service

A partner manager from our team will keep the ball rolling and be available whenever you need us.

## Teamwork makes the dream work

Whether you're looking to resell our software, build an integration or share our product with your audience, we've got a partner program for you.

### Resellers

For companies looking to expand their revenue streams and grow their business. Gain access to product discounts and program benefits.

### Customer Referral

Loving Help Scout and want to spread the word? Earn $100 every time you refer a friend.

### Affiliates

For those with a customer support audience, who might be a content creator, agency, blogger, or someone in between — but you know the ins and outs of the industry. You refer, we reward!

### Integrations

For businesses and developers who want to integrate their platform, tool, or software with Help Scout's open API. Supercharge our mutual customers.

> Our partnership with Help Scout has been transformative. The seamless collaboration and dedicated support have not only streamlined our program setup but also enhanced the overall efficiency of our GTM operations.

## Join the growing list of companies we're proud to call partners
